name: Bun ken
summary: A noodle bowl with Cambodian roots, in a broth of dried fish, coconut milk, and a dash of curry powder.
origin: Phu Quoc. The nature account gives the broth and the Cambodian origins.
taste: Dried fish, coconut milk, and a dash of curry powder. No further seasoning was printed.
howToEat: Order it at a noodle stall during your trip.
